experiment: Expert-wise GPTQ/AGQ hybrid: small-scale feasibility MVP
nature: retrospective exploratory pilot; one calibration seed; outcome-informed layer choice
layer_choice_caveat: L8 (AGQ slightly worse) and L16 (AGQ best) were chosen WITH knowledge of earlier AGQ results; not an independent confirmatory sample

tune.note: historical tuning split; disjoint from the C4 pool rows 0-1999 the FR s0 calibration set was drawn from; the ONLY split used for expert selection and the layer-wise baseline choice

confirm.note: document-disjoint confirmation split; identical windows to runs_legacy_metric_reeval; inspected in earlier studies -> not pristine

oldtest.note: historical test rows 2128-2255; inspected in many prior studies

selection.score: J_e^(q) = sum_{i: e in top4(i)} c_{i,e}^2 ||E_e^FP(x_i) - E_e^(q)(x_i)||_2^2 on the tuning split; full expert MLP output in fp32 from BF16 weights; c = fp32 softmax top-4 router value of the BF16 model (no renormalization); frozen BF16 layer inputs (non-sequential)
selection.rule: z_e = 1 (AGQ) iff J_e^(1) < J_e^(0); otherwise (incl. ties) 0 (GPTQ); all three projections of one candidate per expert

baselines.LAYERWISE: per layer, all-AGQ iff its actual aggregated layer-output error on the TUNING split is strictly lower than all-GPTQ; else all-GPTQ

evaluation.metric: E_layer = sum_x ||y_BF16 - y_q||^2 / (sum_x ||y_BF16||^2 + 1e-30), fp32 expert math, float64 sums, shared expert included, frozen BF16 router/top-4/coefficients (LayerEvalAccumulator definition)
evaluation.aggregate: mean of the two per-layer ratios (2-layer scope; not comparable to 4-layer historical means)
evaluation.native_check: actual BF16 Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock forward with installed weights (secondary)
evaluation.decomposition: ||dy||^2 = D + C, D = sum_k ||c_k dE_k||^2, C = 2 sum_{a<b} <c_a dE_a, c_b dE_b>
evaluation.paired: per-window ratio differences, fraction of windows improved, window bootstrap of the 2-layer mean relative difference (2000 reps, windows resampled jointly across layers)

decision_rule.HYBRID_PROMISING: all of: (1) 2-layer mean hybrid error < uniform GPTQ and < uniform AGQ; (2) < layer-wise uniform; (3) rel diff vs strongest of GPTQ/AGQ/LAYERWISE <= -tau; (4) per layer, hybrid rel diff vs the better uniform method of that layer <= +tau; (5) transfer: pooled per-expert val->test sign agreement >= 0.65 AND Spearman of per-expert relative improvement >= 0.5 (primary split); (6) correctness passes
decision_rule.HYBRID_SELECTION_FAIL: not promising, transfer criterion (5) fails, and hybrid does not improve on either uniform method by >= tau
decision_rule.HYBRID_LOCAL_ONLY: not the above; hybrid improves on BOTH uniform methods by >= tau but not on the strongest non-hybrid baseline (layer-wise) by >= tau
decision_rule.HYBRID_BLOCKED: candidate weights not reproducible or any correctness check fails

recommendation.B: hybrid not better than layer-wise by >= tau AND layer-wise beats both uniform methods (2-layer mean)
